setting: Mill loft, winter night, one oil lamp, snow on the shutters, Tomas at a workbench behind them
action: Vesper (12) inks soot across Orin's (9) small palms with her thumb while he squirms; Tomas hums and watches them with a tired, enormous love
lines: Left hand opens. Right hand shuts. Say it, boy.

setting: Wickhollow at dusk, aerial, a bowl of ash-trees and black peat, cottage lamps, a faint heat-shimmer ring in the woods
action: Slow crane down over the village as bread-smoke rises and children run home through the mud; the shimmer in the trees pulses once like a breath

setting: The flooded mill-race at night, black water, torn timber, driving rain
action: Tomas drags the boy up the bank by his coat and shoves him to safety, then the current takes him against the wheel; Orin's eyebrow splits on a stone; he screams and crawls to the still body
lines: Go. Go on. I've got you.

setting: Mud bank beside the mill-race, lantern guttering, rain, a grave-lantern burning at a distant mother's grave
action: Vesper (12) kneels over Tomas's body, draws ash across his chest, cuts her own throat's skin with a small knife, speaks the words with her eyes open; she turns Orin's face away with both hands
lines: Look at me, Orin. Don't look at him. Look at me.

setting: Same mud bank, grey pre-dawn, fog
action: Tomas sits up in the mud, gasping, and takes the boy in both arms; his eyes open a half-second too long over Orin's shoulder; at the edge of the lamplight Sera Valek arrives and stops dead
lines: I'm here. I'm here, boy. I've got you.

setting: Wickhollow mill, daytime, nine years later, flour-dust in shafts of light
action: Orin (18) stacks grain sacks beside his father who works untiring; Tomas looks up and smiles one second too long; Orin looks at the floor

setting: The loft, one candle, rain on the roof, nine years on
action: Vesper (21) sits on the edge of the bed with her fingertips resting on the scar at her throat; Orin (18) stands in the doorway, not coming closer
lines: You keep looking at me like I'm the one who's sorry.
Every day. And I'd do it again.

setting: The loft, closer, rain on the shutters
action: She stands and takes his soot-stained hand and presses it flat to her throat scar; forehead to forehead, breath mixing; adult heat held in check
lines: Say my name like you mean it.

setting: Wickhollow's edge, dawn mist at the tree line, hunters silhouetted behind
action: Silver Hade steps out of the white mist in Order leathers, crossbow low, the nail-brand on his wrist; Orin freezes with a bucket in each hand
lines: Orin. Don't run. I know how you stand when you're about to run.

setting: Mill yard, grey morning, mist, a ring of hunters with white-ash crossbows
action: Brother Aldren on foot, calm as a headmaster, stops ten paces from Tomas who stands holding a flour sack; the hunters do not breathe
lines: Nine years of warmth in a graveyard, Mr Calder. Do you know what that costs?

setting: Mill yard in the raid, smoke, bolts hissing
action: A white-ash bolt takes Tomas in the chest; he looks down at it, pulls it out slowly, and smiles; Orin cries out; Vesper's hand goes to her throat

setting: Burning mill yard, handheld chaos
action: Tomas moves with a stillness no man has; hunters fall with their joints undone and breath stolen, no spell effects, just hands; Mara Quill watches him, shaking, bolt unfired
lines: That's not a man. That's a lid.

setting: Forest track at night, Wickhollow burning behind, rain; Tomas follows them not out of breath
action: Orin and Vesper run, hand in hand, mud to the knees; Orin glances back at his father who has not stopped smiling

setting: Sera's fen house, a shadow on the wall that does not match the candle, bundled herbs, wet wood
action: Sera stands over Vesper, absolutely still, the clouded eye catching light; Vesper stares back with nine years of defiance
lines: You didn't bring him back. You opened the door.

setting: Crowded river-market, lantern strings, rain-slick cobbles
action: Lazlo Vane leans too close, flashing the gold tooth, selling forged papers and salt; Orin keeps a hand on his knife; Vesper's eyes go narrow
lines: Two on a bounty. One pretty, one pretty angry. I'll give you a discount on the second.
How much to not tell them?

setting: Overgrown burying-ground at dusk, crooked stones, a freshly dug hole, lantern
action: Noll lays his dirty hand on a grave, tilts his head, smiles at the ground the way other people smile at dogs, then looks at Orin
lines: Body's there. Soul's elsewhere. Your da's grave is the loudest in four counties.

setting: Barn at night, one lantern, rope, straw
action: Orin ties his father's wrists with trembling hands; Tomas, himself for one stretched moment, sweating and weeping, tilts his head back as if something presses from inside his skull
lines: Tighter, Orin. Please. I can feel him pressing.

setting: Campfire in a ruined chapel, sparks and smoke, rain through the roof
action: Vesper grabs Orin's collar, face inches from his; the almost-kiss; from the shadows Tomas says a name neither of them knows
lines: Don't you dare offer yourself as bait again.

setting: A widow's townhouse, red-lit by a single fire, dark silk and old wine, a hint of old blood on a cloth
action: Lady Veyra pours a glass and does not drink it; she looks at Vesper like a long-awaited guest
lines: Vampire hunter is the founding myth. The Order stretched the word until it meant anyone who will not die correctly.

setting: Order camp tent, night, a file open on a trunk
action: Mara holds out the Order's file to Silver; Silver reads and the colour leaves his face
lines: It wasn't a vampire, Silver. It was never a vampire.
Then what did they kill my family for?

setting: Cathedral nave of the Order, candle-lit, long shadows
action: Aldren lays a hand on Silver's shoulder, paternal and unmoving
lines: One seating can unmake a march. Someone must be the monster so the children do not have to.

setting: Candlelit cellar, strangers bound on chairs, blood-ink on the walls
action: Thorn Marrow, fever-bright, turns from a seated stranger and sees Vesper; he looks at her like a student at a forbidden book
lines: You were the first brave thing in five hundred years.

setting: Wickhollow's burnt cellar, a stone well sealed with iron
action: Sera lifts the iron lid a hand's breadth; a cold breath comes out; Vesper steps back as if struck
lines: Your mother and his father were keepers. They knew what was under the village.

setting: Ruined mill at dawn, hunters in a ring, Tomas kneeling bound before them
action: Aldren hands Silver a white-ash bolt; Silver raises the crossbow at Tomas, hands shaking; Orin screams at him to stop

setting: The sealed well, stone steps, a cold wind pulling at her hair, torches guttering
action: Vesper steps up to the lip of the well; Orin grabs her wrist; she looks at him with absolute tenderness and certainty
lines: Someone has to be the lid.

setting: A heavy wooden door in the dark, a thin line of light under it
action: Orin and Vesper on opposite sides, each with a palm pressed flat on the wood, her voice not quite her own

setting: The mill-race bank at dawn, still water, mist
action: Tomas, fully himself for one last second, cups his son's face in both hands and smiles the right length
lines: You said please. That's all a father needs. Now say goodbye.

setting: Black void with a single candle
action: Smash to black. Vesper's face, half in candlelight, looks straight into the lens, the scar at her throat catching the flame; title CONJURER'S SOUL fades in as a single hard cut
lines: How much of yours will you spend?
